recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Cockroach Janta Party** (CJP), a youth-led satirical political group, had its website taken down on Saturday, May 23, 2026 at 9 a.m.  Founder Abhijeet Dipke accused the **Indian Government** of orchestrating the takedown, claiming it was due to the CJP's growing popularity and online movement demanding the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan following the NEET-UG 2026 paper leak. The CJP, formed in response to Chief Justice of India Surya Kant’s controversial “cockroach” remark, rapidly gained traction with over 22 million followers on social media before being blocked by authorities citing national security concerns. Dipke claims his personal accounts were also hacked and he has received death threats.  Despite the takedown, the CJP is not yet a registered political party.

recent_articles.title: Is pragmatism replacing ideology in international affairs? | Business and Economy News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The United States** and **India** are seeking to mend diplomatic ties after a year of tension, highlighting the increasing complexity and interconnectivity in international relations.  **Professor emeritus of strategic studies at the Centre for Policy Research**, **Brahma Chellaney**, argues that pragmatism is replacing ideology in today's diplomatic landscape, while **Chief executive officer at Macro-Advisory strategic consultancy**, **Chris Weafer**, suggests that overlapping interests are driving this shift.

recent_articles.title: Power cuts caused by load issues, not shortage, says Minister R. Nirmalkumar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Minister for Energy Resources and Law R. Nirmalkumar** stated that recent power cuts in Chennai and other districts were due to increased demand during the summer, not a shortage of supply. **Mr. Nirmalkumar** explained that the **Electricity Department** is addressing issues with load management, rapid response teams, and call centers to resolve complaints promptly. The department faces financial distress and is implementing reforms to improve efficiency and address outstanding debt.

recent_articles.title: Trump says peace deal with Iran ‘largely negotiated’ with strait of Hormuz to open | US-Israel war on Iran | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Donald Trump** announced on Saturday that a peace deal with **Iran** has been largely negotiated, potentially ending the US-Israel war launched in February. The deal is expected to include an official declaration of the war's end, two-month negotiations on Iran's nuclear program, the opening of the strait of Hormuz by **Iran**, and an end to the US blockade of Iranian ports. The details of the agreement remain unclear.

recent_articles.title: ‘Fjord’ by Romania’s Cristian Mungiu wins Cannes top film prize | Cinema News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Cristian Mungiu**, Romanian director, won the prestigious Palme d’Or for his film "Fjord" at the Cannes Film Festival. The Grand Prix went to **Andrey Zvyagintsev's** Russian war drama "Minotaur," while **Virginie Efira** and **Tao Okamoto** won best actress and actor awards for their roles in the film "All of a Sudden."

recent_articles.title: ₹350 crore investment to generate 2,300 employment opportunities in Bihar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bihar Industrial Area Development Authority (BIADA)** approved 20 industrial projects during a meeting chaired by Secretary, Industries Department and MD of BIADA, **Kundan Kumar**. recent_articles.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** called an emergency meeting of his national security team on Saturday regarding Iran, as **Vice President JD Vance**, and other top negotiators including **Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalifbaf** and **Jared Kushner** have approved a draft peace deal.  **Trump** skipped his son's wedding in the Bahamas to attend the meeting, prompting speculation about the significance of the event.

recent_articles.title: No refunds for 15,000 Australian ticket holders after Candace Owens’ tour cancelled | Australia news | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Candace Owens**, a conservative commentator, is out hundreds of thousands of dollars after her Australian tour was cancelled by the company **Rocksman**, which has declared bankruptcy. recent_articles.title: Chennai and surrounding areas to experience cloudy weather - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chennai** experienced cloudy skies on Saturday due to a low-level circulation over the central Bay of Bengal and a north–south trough. **V.R. Durai**, Director, Regional Weather Forecasting Centre, explained that this interaction caused enhanced moisture incursion and strong onshore winds, leading to widespread low and mid-level clouds. Residents reported a sandstorm at Marina Beach, while Sunday is expected to be cloudy with heavy rain possible in isolated areas of Tamil Nadu and surrounding regions.

recent_articles.title: Twisha Sharma death case: husband Samarth Singh brought to Bhopal, police to seek remand - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samarth Singh**, the husband of Twisha Sharma, who was found dead in her marital home on May 12th, 2026, was arrested by **Madhya Pradesh police** after he surrendered at a Jabalpur district court. recent_articles.title: 68% of flyover on Anna Salai completed despite delays due to war, labour shortage - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **State Highways Department** officials report that nearly 68% of the construction project for a flyover on Anna Salai, connecting Saidapet and Teynampet, has been completed.  The project is expected to be finished by September with 32 out of 131 decks in place. The completion of the flyover will involve placing slabs on girders, completing foundation work for pillars, and installing approach ramps and crash barriers.
